subject: Mutual plan kickoff — align goals, stakeholders, and timeline
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novumhealth.com>, Tom Graves <t.graves@novumhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual plan kickoff — align goals, stakeholders, and timeline

Hi Samira / Tom,

Great to meet you both last week. As discussed with Samira, I wanted to put a short mutual action plan (MAP) kickoff on paper so we have a shared view of goals, stakeholders, and a target close/evaluation window. The aim is to get Novum through a safe, measurable 4–6 week evaluation and give your champions the evidence they need for procurement.

High level proposal (first pass):
- Objective: Validate Redwood Inference on clinical QA workflows for claims triage (accuracy + latency targets)
- Success criteria: 1) >= 92% precision on the labeled test set you shared; 2) average 95th percentile latency <= 650ms under expected concurrency; 3) integration demo with your prod-like dataset
- Suggested timeline: kickoff week of May 4 -> evaluation wrap by June 7 (~5 weeks)
- Core owners: Samira (Champion / Product), Tom (Procurement), Priyom (AE), Marissa (Customer Success)

I attached a lightweight MAP template and an evaluation checklist to make it easier to agree on milestones. If that looks good I’ll schedule a 30m kickoff next week to walk through responsibilities and data handoffs.

Next steps I’m proposing:
1) You confirm champion+stakeholders and any constraints on data access
2) We lock a kickoff time (30m) and I’ll share a calendar invite + Drive folder
3) We finalize pass/fail criteria in the template during the kickoff

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-map-template-v1.xlsx (Excel)], [Attachment: evaluation-checklist.pdf (PDF)]

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

—Priyom
Priyom Das | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
pri_yom@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0194

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novumhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Graves <t.graves@novumhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual plan kickoff — align goals, stakeholders, and timeline

Priyom — thanks for the clear summary. This aligns with what I was thinking. A couple of notes from our side:

- Timeline: 5 weeks sounds reasonable; can we aim to wrap by June 4 instead of June 7 (internal exec review is on June 8).
- Stakeholders: I’ll be the champion (Product). I’m looping in Marcus Li (Head of Data) for technical validation and Erika Santos (Clinical Ops) for output sampling — I’ll include their emails on the kickoff invite.
- Data: We can provide a redacted sample data extract by May 7; full access will depend on a short IP/data-use agreement but we can work around that for evaluation if needed.

Kickoff availability: May 5 or May 6 between 9–12 PT works for me.

Please include an agenda in the invite that covers: roles, data exchange plan, evaluation checkpoints, and sign-off criteria.

Best,
Samira Khan
Director of Product, Novum Health
samira.khan@novumhealth.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novumhealth.com>, Tom Graves <t.graves@novumhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual plan kickoff — align goals, stakeholders, and timeline

Thanks Samira — that schedule works. Per your preference I’ve moved the target wrap date to June 4. I’ll prepare the agenda and a one-page checklist to circulate before the call.

Proposed kickoff: May 5, 10:00–10:30 PT (30m) — will send calendar invite in a minute. Agenda (draft):
1) Introductions & success criteria (5m)
2) Data access & redaction plan (8m)
3) Evaluation milestones & roles (8m)
4) Next steps: integrations, security checklist, and procurement timeline (9m)

I attached the MAP template again and added a link to a shared Drive folder where we’ll keep test datasets and results. Please reply if Marcus / Erika need different timing.

Related links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcdEFghIJkL

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-map-template-v1.xlsx (Excel)]

—Priyom
Priyom Das | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@novumhealth.com>
Cc: Tom Graves <t.graves@novumhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual plan kickoff — align goals, stakeholders, and timeline

Appreciate the crisp plan here. Quick internal ask from my side: please include a short section in the MAP that lists expected unit economics for the eval (estimated token spend + any ephemeral infra costs) and the SLOs we’ll be committing to for the demo environment. Samira — that will help your procurement team when Tom runs the numbers.

I’m happy to join the kickoff for the first 10m to cover deployment constraints if helpful.

—Rishi

Redwood Inference
